background_rejection.calibration: Discovery blank double-strand maximum scores of RAW PWM
background_rejection.action: reject selected instance below threshold; require20 promoters; rebuild once

candidate_ranking: Discovery positive minus Discovery blank sequence presence at rebuilt PWM's Discovery-blank maximum-score95th percentile; descending, ties: information bits descending, support count descending, candidate id ascending; no reference or truth

views.CAP5: top min(5,available) by frozen Discovery ranking, underfill retained and reported
views.MATCH_OH24: EMB128 and OH24 each top m=min(5,n_EMB,n_OH24)
views.MATCH_OH48: EMB128 and OH48 each top m=min(5,n_EMB,n_OH48)

underfill_policy: zero common budget yields0 F1 for both, never dropped or counted as win; retain FULL and CAP5 to expose performance suppressed by common-min trimming
primary_endpoint: mut30_random, BG_ONLY, MATCH_OH48: EMB128-minus-OH48 reference-assisted localizationF1, average3 cluster seeds inside each data seed first
secondary_endpoints: FULL, CAP5, OH24 comparison, strong control, mixed strand, candidate-family blankFPR and budget coverage; exploratory
interpretation_gate: only advance an advantage claim for further study if matched and CAP5 mean deltas both positive, at least4/5 matched data-seed wins, no zero common budget, and matched family blankFPR <= OH48; not functional or general superiority proof
statistics: 5 independent synthetic data repeats; clustering seeds not extra samples; report paired deltas, wins, min/max and exact two-sided sign-flip mean test over32 sign assignments; n5 minimum two-sided p=.0625, no p<.05 claim possible
test_policy: all fits, Discovery ranks and every candidate membership locked before Development/Test scoring; no Test-based ranking, tuning or subset choice; any later method change requires new Test seeds
